primitives.name: Platform Enforcement Risk
primitives.verbatim_quote: **The non-negotiable honesty rule:** Report the real enforcement and legal risks even when the news is bad.
primitives.assumptions: Risk scales linearly with flag frequency and strike history; platform policies are deterministic.

layer2.mapping: Risk kernel derived from platform-specific violation matrices and historical enforcement logs.
layer2.telemetry: Account suspension rate, post removal frequency

primitives.name: Content ID Claims
primitives.verbatim_quote: Your output will be executed literally — write for an executor: exact endpoints, exact URLs, exact steps, exact numbers.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{claim}': 'Claimed content count (integer)', 'C_{manual}': 'Manually claimed content (binary)', 'F_{strike}': 'Strike frequency (per 1000 posts)'}
primitives.assumptions: Manual claims are less frequent than automated Content ID; strikes correlate with copyright violations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F_{strike} → ∞ as C_{claim} increases without counter-notice

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to platform DMCA takedown models with probabilistic claim resolution.
layer2.telemetry: Strike rate per channel, claim denial ratio

primitives.name: Viral Timing Window
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every recommendation must serve one goal: real sports videos that go viral, posted at the right time, from the right accounts, through the right pipes.
primitives.assumptions: Viral spikes occur within ±15 minutes of game events; E_{eng} is maximized at T_{window} = W_{game}

layer2.mapping: Kernel of temporal correlation between game events and viral clip performance.
layer2.telemetry: Clip view count, share rate, time-to-viral threshold
